_comment: Real character roster for a self-hosted deployment. Copy this file to roster.json
and edit it to list YOUR players, then run provisioning (setup-matrix.mjs) or start
the sidecar with VP_AUTO_PROVISION=1. When roster.json is present it REPLACES the
built-in a/b/c/staff demo cast; the game rooms/map still come from seed.json.
Per character:
username       required. Matrix localpart (lowercase letters, digits, . _ = - /).
The Matrix id becomes @<username>:<MATRIX_SERVER_NAME> (default 'local').
display_name   shown name in chat/roster. Defaults to username.
password       this player's Matrix login password. If omitted, the shared
MATRIX_DEMO_PASSWORD / MATRIX_PASSWORD env value is used at
provisioning time. Prefer per-player passwords for a real game.
is_staff       true = Narratore/GM: sees hidden PCs, reads the staff event log,
owns room creation. Give at least one character this.
powers         discipline power codes the character owns. Obfuscate/Auspex are the
Phase-1 mechanics: obf1/obf2 (Oscurazione lvl 1/2),
ott1/ott2 (Ottenebramento lvl 1/2), aus1/aus2 (Auspex lvl 1/2).
mental_points  starting/refill mental pool (powers cost 1 each; activation needs 2+).
Any other sheet field (clan, status, citta, natura, gen, umanita, fis, soc, blood,
will, abilita, disciplines, note, tempo_px, ...) may also be set per character; unset
fields fall back to a sane default sheet. Delete this _comment block in your real file.
IMPORTANT: roster.json is gitignored and excluded from the Docker image because it
can hold passwords. Mount it into the container (see SELF-HOST.md) rather than baking it.
